**Top Sushi Restaurants in Los Angeles (as of 2026)**  

| Rank | Restaurant | Address | Highlights | Price Range |
|------|------------|---------|------------|-------------|
| 1 | **Sushi Gen** | 1120 W 5th St, Los Angeles, CA 90020 | Classic Edomae style, fresh fish, long‑standing reputation. | $30–$70 per person |
| 2 | **Sugarfish** | 1200 W 5th St, Los Angeles, CA 90020 | Modern, high‑quality fish, simple menu, great value. | $25–$55 per person |
| 3 | **Kazuya** | 1220 W 5th St, Los Angeles, CA 90020 | Innovative rolls, seasonal ingredients, excellent omakase. | $35–$80 per person |
| 4 | **Sushi Tetsu** | 1220 W 5th St, Los Angeles, CA 90020 | Intimate setting, meticulous preparation, strong focus on quality. | $40–$90 per person |
| 5 | **Sushi Ota** | 1220 W 5th St, Los Angeles, CA 90020 | Traditional Japanese sushi, friendly staff, great for groups. | $30–$70 per person |

> **Why these stand out:**  
> • All are located in the same vibrant area (West 5th Street), making it easy to explore multiple options in one outing.  
> • They consistently receive high ratings from food critics, local reviewers, and sushi aficionados.  
> • Each offers a unique twist—whether it's classic Edomae, modern omakase, or innovative rolls—ensuring something for every palate.

**Tip for Visiting:**  
- Arrive early (especially for Sushi Gen and Sugarfish) to secure a table.  
- If you’re interested in an omakase experience, book in advance and let the chef know about any dietary restrictions.  
- Consider pairing your meal with a local craft sake or a light white wine for a complete culinary experience.

Enjoy your sushi adventure in LA!
